future_c6_requirements: Source-bound provider failure must be detected BEFORE transactional side effects
Opted-in stale source must not write HANDOVER_PLANNED, snapshot, context or lease renewal
Crash after staging/apply must recover atomically without silently minting custody
Unknown post-crash external mutation requires manual reconciliation rather than blind rollback
A single successful opt-in source-bound handover must carry full graph/plan/input/provider digests into real transaction output
Unaided cold successor must check current GitHub provider and source against frozen basis
